## What it makes

Two alternative audio takes of the same scene, such as a rainy harbour at night. It is for video makers and game designers who need atmosphere or effects but do not want to write technical sound prompts. The idea: a language model acts as the sound designer and turns a loose scene into a clear list of sounds with distance and mood, and Seed Audio renders it twice so you can pick the better take.

## The workflow

<Shot src="templates/sound-design-workflow.webp" alt="The Sound Design template in three groups: scene, sound prompt from the LLM, render with Seed Audio" caption="Three groups from the scene text to the two saved takes." />

1. A **Scene description (change me)** text node holds the idea. The template describes thunder, creaking ropes on boats and a fisherman humming a sea shanty.
2. **[BytePlus LLM](../../nodes/byteplus-llm/)** (Seed 2.1 Turbo, titled "Sound designer") writes one sound-design paragraph of at most 60 words: each sound, its distance and its mood. A **Preview as Text** node shows the prompt.
3. **[Seed Audio 1.0](../../nodes/seed-audio/)** turns the prompt into sound with `reference_mode` text only, and `generation_count` set to 2 so you get two takes.
4. **Save Audio (Advanced)** (titled "Save the takes") keeps both takes as MP3 files in `BytePlus/Audio/sound_design`.

## Run it

1. Add your ModelArk API key and your Seed Speech API key in **Settings → BytePlus** if you have not yet ([API keys](../../get-started/api-keys/)). The template needs both.
2. Open the template browser and choose **Sound Design** under BytePlus.
3. Replace the text in **Scene description (change me)** with your own scene.
4. Press **Run**. Read the sound prompt first, then listen to both takes.

## Settings worth changing

- **Scene description:** name the place, the time and two or three sounds you must hear.
- **`generation_count`:** each take is a separate request, run in parallel and billed on its own. More takes means more choice and more cost.
- **System prompt of the LLM:** change the word limit or the style, for example "film foley" instead of ambience.
- **`audio_format` and `sample_rate`:** the node produces WAV at 24000 Hz here, and Save Audio (Advanced) converts to MP3 at quality V0. Change its format if you need a lossless file.
- **`reference_mode`:** switch from text only to audio reference (clone up to three voices), image reference (derive a voice from a character image) or preset voice (a built-in voice reads the prompt).

## Time and cost

The LLM bills on your ModelArk account; Seed Audio bills on your Seed Speech account, and each take is a separate request. The seed controls are set to `randomize`, so every run writes a new prompt and two new takes and bills again. Set a control to `fixed` and ComfyUI reuses the cached result of an unchanged node without billing. The two takes differ from each other (34.5 and 24.0 seconds in this example), so listen to both.
